paper.methods: Single perturbation benchmark setup; equations 1 and 3

official_implementation.input_unit: per-condition mean of assay X, one gene per row and one condition per column; X averaged by glmGamPoi pseudobulk default rowMeans2
official_implementation.PCA: prcomp_irlba(Y_post_train, n=10), center=TRUE across genes within each condition column, scale.=FALSE; gene score matrix G=U times singular values, not just loadings or U
official_implementation.P: rows of G for training perturbed target genes; test P rows are held-out target genes measured as readouts in training perturbations
official_implementation.regression: Y_change=Y_post-control_mean; subtract per-gene training-condition mean; W=solve(GtG+0.1I,Gt Ycenter P) @ inverse(PtP+0.1I)
official_implementation.prediction: G W Ptest.T + per-gene mean(Y_change) + control_mean; for signed delta omit final control_mean addition
official_implementation.control_training_column: Official code explicitly adds ctrl to train, includes ctrl in PCA, and uses zero P_ctrl; current adaptation deliberately omits this training column

conclusions: All frozen 64/58 target identities exist in full source genes; exact gene embedding lookup is feasible.
responses.A alone contains perturbation-minus-matched-control deltas, so its PCA is not the official absolute-expression PCA. Reconstruct pert_A X means.
Refit all preprocessing, PCA, b and W inside each target fold using training A only. Keeping a held-out target as a measured readout gene is allowed; its perturbed A column is excluded.
Within-fold test-target mismatch is required; global cross-fold mismatch would mix source predictors trained on the query target.
Use the published two-sided regularized matrix solve, not a single sklearn Ridge penalty on a Kronecker design.

frozen_adaptation.training_conditions: training fold perturbations only; no ctrl column
frozen_adaptation.baseline: independent existing 400 Dm cells in source X; common subtraction for linear and training-mean predictions
frozen_adaptation.scope: PCA uses all 5043/5025 source genes; evaluation uses frozen970/982 candidate scope
additional_limits: Absolute A means come from one technical library pool; Dm baseline is another library pool, so offsets can enter signed prediction errors.
Supervised training receives other perturbation A outcomes, unlike control-only native/Pearson baselines. Different information budgets preclude a flat superiority claim.
Upstream all-cell HVG selection remains; architecture adaptation does not reproduce the published dataset split or benchmark numbers.
